svg.aria-label: Animated CI/CD, request/response and scheduled-job architecture: a git push builds, tests and dockerizes project-svc with GitHub Actions, pushes the image to Amazon ECR and deploys it on ECS; then a user request through CloudFront and API Gateway, JWT check with Keycloak, Spring Boot service querying PostgreSQL, 200 OK response back to the user, then a Kafka event consumed by notify and realtime services, then a Quartz scheduled job that sends due-date reminders and marks an unfinished project overdue, emailing the team and updating the board live, with a trace waterfall and live log on the same clock
svg.text: git push main → GitHub Actions pipeline starts
CI: mvn build → JUnit tests → docker build project-svc:v42
CD: ECS rolling deploy → project-svc v42 live (2/2 healthy)
Authorization: Bearer <jwt> → Keycloak verifies token + role
routed to project-svc · controller → service → repository
SELECT * FROM projects WHERE tenant_id = ? → rows returned
200 OK application/json → back through Gateway + CDN to the user
async: event on Kafka → email sent + WebSocket push to the user
✔ round trip complete · user got the response + a live update
reminders (in-app + email) before the due date: every 12h (3 days) → 6h (2 days) → 3h (last day)
due time reached · project still open → Quartz DueDateJob fires
UPDATE projects SET status = 'OVERDUE' WHERE id = ? AND status <> 'DONE'
event project.overdue on Kafka → email + in-app notification
live update: the board shows OVERDUE for everyone, no refresh
⎈ last deploy · project-svc:v42 · build 38s · 142 tests ✓ · rollout 2/2

text.tspan: github: push main → a41f9c2 · pipeline started
cloudfront: cache MISS → forward to origin
quartz: DueDateJob fired · project #4821 due now
